title_zh: NAVER、NVIDIA 与 Brookfield 将扩展韩国国家级人工智能工厂基础设施
title_en: NAVER, NVIDIA and Brookfield to Expand Korea’s National AI Factory Infrastructure Buildout
summary_zh: NAVER、NVIDIA 与 Brookfield 宣布计划扩大韩国主权人工智能工厂基础设施投资，将最初的 NVIDIA® DSX™ AI 工厂部署规模从55兆瓦扩大至200兆瓦，增长超过三倍。NAVER 计划将其 NVIDIA AI 基础设施部署扩展到1吉瓦。
summary_en: NAVER, NVIDIA and Brookfield announced a proposed expansion of Korea's sovereign AI factory infrastructure. The investment will increase the initial NVIDIA® DSX™ AI factory deployment from 55 megawatts to 200 megawatts, more than tripling the buildout. NAVER intends to expand its NVIDIA AI infrastructure deployment to 1 gigawatt.
why_it_matters_zh: 通过大幅增加AI工厂规模，韩国将提升其人工智能研发和应用能力，推动科技产业发展并增强全球竞争力。
why_it_matters_en: By significantly expanding AI factory capacity, Korea aims to enhance its AI research and applications, driving technological industry growth and strengthening global competitiveness.

title_zh: SK集团与NVIDIA扩展战略合作，聚焦AI工厂与下一代存储
title_en: SK Group and NVIDIA Expand Strategic Partnership Across AI Factories and Next-Generation Memory
summary_zh: SK集团与NVIDIA宣布超过5000亿美元的全面合作计划，旨在建设满足全球计算需求的AI基础设施。双方签署意向书，合作内容涵盖AI工厂建设及AI存储供应。
summary_en: SK Group and NVIDIA announced plans for a comprehensive partnership worth over $500 billion to build AI infrastructure catering to global computing demand. They signed letters of intent covering collaboration from AI factory construction to AI memory supply.
why_it_matters_zh: 随着AI计算需求激增，SK集团与NVIDIA的合作将推动AI硬件和内存供应链的发展，助力AI技术和产业的蓬勃发展。
why_it_matters_en: As AI computing demands surge, the partnership between SK Group and NVIDIA will advance AI hardware and memory supply chains, fostering growth in AI technology and industry.
